name: TOTP Turn Off Flow Handler
summary: Provides the typed application boundary for removing an enrolled TOTP factor after validating the durable factor is enabled.
notes: The handler owns the enabled-TOTP guard and delegates the actual secure-secret removal and MFA-state mutation to IAppUserMfaManager.
AuthenticationFlowService is the stable application front door used by the REST endpoint.

sourceReferences.note: Implemented typed handler and canonical transition ownership.
DisableMfaAsync performs the real secure MFA cleanup.
